tweets.text: It was a productive week here in Washington before heading back home for the district work period. The House passed my bipartisan Main Street Capital Access Act, which will help free up our local community banks to better serve Arkansas's entrepreneurs, businesses owners, and farmers. I was also pleased to join Oversight and Investigations Subcommittee Chairman Dan Meuser as we released our Committee staff report, "Fighting Back: A Policy Framework for Combating the Rise of Financial Fraud & Scams." Financial fraud is one of the fastest-growing threats facing Americans, costing consumers and financial institutions billions of dollars each year. As Chairman of the House Financial Services Committee, protecting Americans from financial fraud remains one of my highest priorities. This report is another important step as we work to combat fraud.
